events.verdict: O'Neale (PHX) brings both hands toward Grant (POR) when he establishes himself in a screening position and then releases away.
Avdija (POR) jumps into a vertical position and his right-hand makes contact with the ball while contesting Booker's (PHX) driving shot attempt.
While attempting to corral the loose ball, Camara's (POR) foot is on the out of bounds line when he makes contact with the ball.
O'Neale (PHX) goes to, not through, Simons's (POR) space, and marginal contact occurs as the two come together.
O'Neale (PHX) avoids bringing both hands to the ball in the backcourt, he maintaining his dribble and then comes to a jump stop to complete the pass.
Simons (POR) and O'Neale (PHX) engage and disengage with one another as they move on the perimeter prior to the pick.
O'Neale (PHX) establishes himself in Grant's (POR) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Simons (POR) commits a take foul on Jones (PHX).
Booker (PHX) commits a take foul on Simons (POR).
Avdija (POR) applies defensive pressure and cleanly dislodges the ball away from Booker (PHX), any additional arm contact is deemed incidental.
Booker (PHX) extends his right forearm and delivers contact to Avdija (POR) on this shot attempt at the rim.
Grant (POR) commits a take foul on Booker (PHX). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Ayton (POR) briefly clamps O'Neale's (PHX) arm while the defender attempts to defend the inbound pass. The contact dissolves quickly.
